name: Theme Showcase with useTheme
summary: Interactive theme inspector using a CodeComponent that leverages the useTheme hook to display all theme tokens. Renders color swatches for light and dark palettes with a Switch toggle, typography scale with fontFamily and headingFontFamily, border-radius visualization boxes, mode indicator badge, all Button variants in a grid, and themed Input examples. Uses Card, Badge, Separator, Label, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: Theme inspector showcasing useTheme hook with color palettes, typography, and component variants
